description: Diff two EdgeGate runs — standard pipeline metrics/gates or Behavioral-Gate summary signals. Reports REGRESSION / IMPROVEMENT / NEUTRAL, or NO BASELINE / NOT COMPARABLE / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE when a reliable comparison cannot be made. Auto-selects a recent PASSED run from the same pipeline when baseline_run_id is omitted. Runs without a pipeline (including Behavioral-Gate runs) require an explicit baseline_run_id with matching eval-set and gate configuration.

baseline_run_id.description: Baseline to compare against. When omitted, auto-selects the most recent PASSED run from the same pipeline (excluding the candidate itself), or the most recent completed run as a fallback. Required for runs without a pipeline, including Behavioral-Gate runs.

name: edgegate_compare_runs
